title: notonia oligodonta

It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Notonia oligodonta include flavonoids, tannins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal activities.
